bullets.title: AVGO: Reaffirms $115B FY27 / $230B FY28 AI revenue targets at GS Communacopia
bullets.body: Broadcom reiterated AI infrastructure revenue roughly doubling each of the next two years to ~$115B in FY27 and ~$230B in FY28, with supply constraints (data center readiness, power, permitting) cited as the main uncertainty rather than chip/memory supply. Management also highlighted securing long-duration custom-silicon relationships with Google through 2031 and OpenAI across multiple generations, while exploring outside capital structures to expand spending capacity for frontier-model developers like Anthropic.

bullets.title: QCOM: Amazon multi-gen AI DC deal reinforces $5B FY27 / $15B FY29 targets; warrants issued
bullets.body: Qualcomm announced a multi-generational custom silicon and optical connectivity collaboration with Amazon, issuing 25M warrants at $161.26 strike vesting over $60B in purchases through 2036; ~$2B revenue contribution expected in FY27 from Amazon alone (ByteDance similar). JPM maintains Neutral ($215 PT), KeyBank maintains Sector Weight ($160 PT, 17x FY27E EPS $9.35). QCOM reiterated FY29 datacenter target of $15B.

bullets.title: ANET: Strong AI networking demand; FY27 margin targets intact despite tariff headwinds
bullets.body: Arista avoided the summer drawdown and flagged durable demand in both AI back-end GPU cluster connectivity and enterprise campus deployments. Scale-across deployments are constrained by power/cooling/space, not demand. Price increases and supply chain efficiencies support FY27 margin targets despite lapping tariff refund benefits.

bullets.title: AMD: Data center +2x in 2027; MI450 GPU ramp accelerates Q4:26 → Q1:27
bullets.body: AMD reiterated data center revenue growth of more than 2x in 2027, with MI450 GPU production commencing Q3:26 and a significant ramp expected in Q4:26 and Q1:27. CPU supply capacity can grow ~80% in H2:26 and ~70% in 2027 despite ongoing constraints; MI450 carries lower margin but incremental gross profit dollars remain the driver.

bullets.title: NTAP: FY27 off to strong start; all-flash +47%, cloud +19%; AI demand broadening to production
bullets.body: NetApp management at Citi TMT was upbeat on FY27 demand, noting the outlook is now higher than 90 days ago and product gross margin has beaten expectations. All-flash grew 47% and public cloud 19% ex. extra week. Customers are transitioning from AI proof-of-concept to larger production deployments, and NTAP is positioning with AFX, AIDE, and DataPelago innovations as an AI data infrastructure company.

bullets.title: HPE: Raises FY27 guidance to 13-17% revenue / 16-20% EPS growth; Oracle win validates portfolio
bullets.body: HPE raised FY27 guidance at Citi TMT: revenue +13-17%, EPS +16-20%, free cash flow at least $5B. Cloud/AI orders grew +76% YoY; $30B+ in long-term supply commitments are an all-time high. The Oracle infrastructure win is viewed as a proof point for larger data center deployments, with the ramp expected 2027+. Leverage fell below 2x ahead of schedule, enabling earlier buybacks.

bullets.title: CSCO: $100B+ upgrade opportunity; AI networking upcycle extends into enterprise and edge
bullets.body: Cisco at GS Communacopia highlighted a durable, multi-year AI networking upcycle extending beyond hyperscalers into enterprise, service providers, and edge. The company has identified $100B+ of end-of-life/end-of-support upgrade opportunity, with underlying networking growing double-digit for eight consecutive quarters. FY27 guidance implies continued strong growth with operating leverage; Cisco plans full independence from merchant silicon by 2029.

bullets.title: SMCI: $60B order book provides visibility; gross margin path to 1.2-2x long-term
bullets.body: Super Micro's SVP of Corporate Development at Citi TMT highlighted a $60B order book driving product and customer expansion, with long-term gross margin potential of 1.2-2x current levels. New sales management and go-to-market investments are underway; Anthropic is an anchor AI customer with demonstrated repeat-contract loyalty.

bullets.title: SNDK: Structural NAND demand shift to datacenter; 2/3 of NBM bits under contract; HBF consortium sampling 2027
bullets.body: Citi is constructive on SanDisk after its CFO presentation, citing AI-driven datacenter demand as NAND's structural new growth engine (KV cache, AI data lakes). Two-thirds of NBM bits are under multi-year contract by next year, with two key customers returning/expanding volume. The HBF consortium with Hynix, Meta, and Google begins sampling in 2027; mobile could see low-single-digit growth in 2027 as mid/high-end content rises.

bullets.title: GLW +7.6%: Verizon 80M-mile fiber LTA broadens AI customer base; $1B DCI target reinforced
bullets.body: JPMorgan highlighted Corning's new LTA with Verizon supplying 80M+ miles of high-density fiber through 2032 for broadband and data center interconnect, expanding Corning's AI customer base beyond its three announced hyperscalers (Meta, Amazon). DCI revenue is targeting $1B annually before decade-end; existing capex plans provide capacity without material additional spend. VIAV and LITE each gained ~11% in sympathy.

bullets.title: WULF: Muskie site generating most interest (6 parties, 2 new); 250-500MW annual contract target reaffirmed
bullets.body: TeraWulf CEO at Citi TMT reaffirmed the ability to contract 250-500MW of incremental IT capacity annually beyond 2030. Muskie is the standout site, scalable to 2GW+ with six parties engaged including two new potential customers. Management indicated a solution to credit backstop concerns is pending and emphasized high customer quality with Anthropic as anchor tenant. WULF was initiated at Buy by Freedom Capital citing Anthropic data center tailwinds.

bullets.title: META: KeyBanc maintains Overweight / $780 PT on Muse AI agent launch
bullets.body: KeyBanc views Meta's Muse personal AI agent (available via app and WhatsApp) as differentiated by Meta's distribution scale, proprietary data, and privacy features including an upcoming Muse Confidential VM. Checkout launches with Stripe Link. Engagement (monthly audience in hundreds of millions) is the near-term success metric; subscriptions are the more meaningful monetization path. Analyst maintains $780 PT (20x 2028E P/E), believing the market underestimates META's AI positioning.

bullets.title: NFLX: Rumored to be establishing theatrical distribution entity; to report box office for first time
bullets.body: Netflix is reportedly contemplating establishing a theatrical distribution entity and reporting box office grosses for the first time across a number of upcoming releases, per Variety. NFLX shares fell 1.9% on the day, likely weighed by geopolitical-driven internet sector weakness rather than the theatrical news specifically.

bullets.title: IONQ: Raises FY26 revenue guidance to $450-460M from $280-290M
bullets.body: IonQ sharply increased its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $450-460M from a prior range of $280-290M, a ~60-65% raise. The stock gained on the day as part of broader strength in quantum/AI-adjacent names.

bullets.title: INTC: +9.1% on Northland Capital upgrade; PC CPU prices expected up another 10%
bullets.body: Intel was upgraded to Outperform at Northland Capital with PC CPU prices expected to rise an additional 10%, complementing a server CPU shortage tailwind. INTC gained 9.1% on the day.

bullets.title: NVDA: Acquires Hugging Face for $12.9B; invests $3.5B into MediaTek
bullets.body: NVIDIA confirmed an agreement to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B including a $1B retention package, and separately invested $3.5B into MediaTek. TSMC flagged it is unable to keep pace with AI demand despite a fivefold capacity expansion, reinforcing the supply-constrained AI infrastructure narrative that underpins NVDA's pricing power.

bullets.title: BE: S&P 500 inclusion effective Sep 21; +9.6% on the day
bullets.body: Bloom Energy was announced as an addition to the S&P 500 effective September 21, 2026, driving a 9.6% single-day gain. OKLO gained 5.0% and NuScale (SMR) surged 15.3% on nuclear/clean energy sentiment.

bullets.title: BKNG: AI 'Connected Trip' strategy still early; B2B consolidation goes live Jan 1; U.S. alt-accommodations a longer-term story
bullets.body: Booking Holdings CEO at Citi TMT cited higher engagement and conversion from Priceline Penny (small sample) and noted Genius loyalty now covers >30% of active customers. The Combined B2B platform (Agoda, Priceline, Booking) launches Jan 1, 2027. Management did not view social media AI agents or new hotel supply as near-term structural threats; U.S. alternative accommodations remain a multi-year growth opportunity dependent on supply build-out.

bullets.title: RCL / CCL: UBS channel checks bullish — bookings mid-to-high single digits ahead of guidance; Norwegian outlier
bullets.body: UBS channel checks show fall Caribbean bookings running mid-to-high single digits YoY, ahead of mid-single-digit guidance, with record-low late-season hurricane activity removing a major overhang. Norwegian is the sole outlier, paying 200-300bps higher agent commissions and showing only mid-single-digit bookings, while Royal Caribbean, Princess, and Holland America perform well. Viking ocean pricing is up high-single-digits for 1H:27; Disney up high-single-digits; Norwegian flat to negative.

bullets.title: TKO: +5% on stronger 2030 sponsorship target visibility and capital return focus
bullets.body: TKO reiterated its $1.2B global partnerships target by 2030 with upward revision opportunity flagged at the 1Q27 Investor Day, and guided WWE partnership revenue growth of 20%+ in 2026 vs. mid-single-digit H1 growth. Management is prioritizing dividends and buybacks over M&A, driving the 5% single-day gain.
